_doc: Superstore Saga: Story Scenes. Binds background assets, music, entry dialogue nodes, and chapter/milestone recap metadata.

scenes.name: MegaMart Careers Online Portal
scenes.ambientDescription: A brightly designed online application portal displaying candidate questions.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You completed the pre-employment assessment and passed with a 98.4% match.

scenes.name: Personnel & Interview Office
scenes.ambientDescription: A neat HR office with motivational posters, employee handbook binders, and a desk where Cheryl conducts interviews.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Cheryl reviewed your application, offered you a position, and presented your badge.
scenes.defaultObjective: Interview with Cheryl and select your career track.

scenes.name: The Associate Locker Room
scenes.ambientDescription: Battleship-gray metal lockers, ozone smell, and fluorescent hum.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Donna assigned you Locker 42 and taught you the three golden rules of survival.
scenes.defaultObjective: Report to the Morning Huddle in Action Alley.

scenes.name: The Associate Breakroom
scenes.ambientDescription: Stained vinyl chairs, a humming vending machine, and burnt microwave popcorn aroma.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You retreated to the breakroom for a lukewarm coffee and a moment of peace.
scenes.defaultObjective: Catch your breath before returning to the sales floor.

scenes.name: Center Action Alley
scenes.ambientDescription: Associates gather around Henderson's yellow milk crate between paper towel towers.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Henderson held the morning huddle and demanded the store cheer.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the morning cheer and report to your station.

scenes.name: Front-End Concourse
scenes.ambientDescription: Beeping barcode scanners, squeaking carts, and an endless line of customers.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You clocked in for your very first shift and engaged the rush crowd.
scenes.defaultObjective: Defend Register 4 against the customer rush.

scenes.name: Backroom Receiving Dock
scenes.ambientDescription: Beeping forklifts, rumbling hydraulic dock levelers, and wooden pallet stacks.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The delivery trucks unloaded and the freight line began moving at maximum speed.
scenes.defaultObjective: Clear the receiving line before the shift supervisor checks velocity.
